annotations.text:
Printing these

Drawn at 8 px = 1 mm, which is 203 dpi — the printer's own resolution. Export an artboard as PNG and drop it into Tiny Print at 100%; don't let it resample.

48 mm is the printable width on a 57 mm roll, so each one is full-bleed edge to edge.

Pure black on white, no grey — thermal has no half-tones, and anything grey comes out as a muddy dither.

All three QRs were checked at true size after a hard black-and-white threshold: they still scan to https://maxgrossman.com.
